picks.text: The new Siri will be partially based on Google technology, with...
picks.full-pick-text: The new Siri will be partially based on Google technology, with...
picks.notes:
• A model based on the Gemini 3.5 Flash family
  • A "translation layer" (MCP or JSON) for App Intents when the Google model is involved
  • No 'Thinking' selector in the UI for users
  • A second $5 side bet: Federico thinks you'll be able to ask what the model is, Myke disagrees.

picks.text: Apple unveils a standalone Siri app
picks.full-pick-text: Apple unveils a standalone Siri app
picks.notes:
• It will be available in the App Store
  • It includes an integrated storefront for downloading chatbot-style AI apps
  • In this store there will be "AI Extensions" for non chatbot-style apps. These will let developers give access to their data to Siri to use for Personal Context. This will be Apple essentially offering MCP support in to the Siri system.

  • Unlocks better image generation in Image Playgrounds
  • Is not part of any existing Apple bundle
